abstract: A new cell line having the ability to metastasize to the lungs in nude mice was established from GCH-1 (human choriocarcinoma cell line). Twenty CD-1 nude mice were injected with GCH-1 cells subcutaneously. A solitary metastatic pulmonary nodule appeared in only one of these mice. The pulmonary nodule was removed and minced, and the dissociated cells obtained were transplanted subcutaneously into new mice. By repeating this process, metastatic pulmonary nodules were seen clearly to have grown in size and number by the 4th transplantation. An in vitro cell line originating in the pulmonary lesion of the 5th transplantation was designated GCH-1 (m). Pulmonary metastasis occurred in all of the mice inoculated with GCH-1 (m) grown in vitro. The doubling time of the parent line GCH-1 and its subline GCH-1 (m) was 22.6 and 36.2 hours, respectively. GCH-1 (m) cells seemed to be heterogeneous in their size and shape compared with GCH-1 cells. GCH-1 (m) secreted more hCG and beta-hCG into the culture medium than GCH-1. By the immunoperoxidase technique using poly- or monoclonal antibodies, GCH-1 (m) showed a clear positive reaction but GCH-1 was only slightly positive for hCG and beta-hCG. Both GCH-1 and GCH-1 (m) were weakly positive for HLA-A, B,C and negative for HLA-DR, SP1 and hPL. Addition of the extracts from mouse lungs to the culture medium obviously promoted the growth of GCH-1 (m) but not of GCH-1.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株GCH-1から、ヌードマウスへの肺転移能を持つ株を樹立した。CD-1ヌードマウス20匹にGCH-1細胞を皮下接種したところ、転移性肺結節は1匹にのみ単発で出現した。この肺結節を摘出して細断し、得られた細胞を新たなマウスに皮下移植した。この操作を繰り返した結果、第4回移植時には転移性肺結節が明らかに大きく、数も増加していた。第5回移植の肺病変に由来する株をin vitroで樹立し、GCH-1(m)と命名した。in vitroで増殖させたGCH-1(m)を接種した全マウスに肺転移が生じた。倍加時間は親株GCH-1とサブラインGCH-1(m)でそれぞれ22.6時間と36.2時間であった。GCH-1(m)細胞はGCH-1と比べてサイズと形態が不均一であった。GCH-1(m)はGCH-1より多くのhCGおよびβ-hCGを培養液中に分泌した。ポリクローナルまたはモノクローナル抗体を用いた免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法では、GCH-1(m)は明らかな陽性反応を示したが、GCH-1はhCGおよびβ-hCGに対してわずかに陽性であった。GCH-1およびGCH-1(m)はいずれもHLA-A,B,Cに弱陽性、HLA-DR、SP1、hPLに陰性であった。マウス肺の抽出物を培養液に添加すると、GCH-1(m)の増殖は明らかに促進されたが、GCH-1では促進されなかった。（抄録は250語で打ち切られている）
